p: What we collect when you buy a ticket or sign up, and what you can ask us to do with it.
When you buy a ticket we collect your name, email, company and payment details. Payments are handled by our ticketing provider; we never see your card number.
To send your ticket, print your badge, email you about the event and, if you agree, tell you about next year.
Our ticketing and email providers, and the venue for the guest list. We never sell your data.
Ticket records for seven years for tax reasons. Marketing consent until you unsubscribe.
You can ask for a copy of your data, correct it or delete it at any time by emailing privacy@uplink.dev.
